description: Search the public skills-hub.ai catalog for skills matching a query. Organization skills are not included unless you pass `organization`; then it searches that organization's skills you can see, including department and team skills (requires signing in once with `npx @skills-hub-ai/cli login`, or SKILLS_HUB_API_TOKEN). Each result includes a `url` to the skill's page on skills-hub.ai; show that link to the user alongside each skill you mention.

organization.description: Organization slug: search that organization's skills you can see instead of the public catalog (requires signing in once with `npx @skills-hub-ai/cli login`, or SKILLS_HUB_API_TOKEN)

name: search_skills
